lines.raw: This is the key idea for anyone who will work with US healthcare data: **each step of the journey creates a record**.
lines.say: This is the key idea for anyone who will work with U S healthcare data: each step of the journey creates a record.

lines.raw: An analyst never watches Emily's visit.
lines.say: An analyst never watches Emily's visit.

lines.raw: They only see the trail of records it leaves.
lines.say: They only see the trail of records it leaves.

lines.raw: Step → who creates it → transaction or document → data produced.
lines.say: Step to who creates it to transaction or document to data produced.

lines.raw: Choose a plan & enroll. Created by: Employer → insurer. Transaction / document: **834** enrollment file, ID card. Data it produces: Eligibility (enrollment span) rows: member, group, plan, start and end dates.
lines.say: Choose a plan and enroll. Created by: Employer to insurer. Transaction or document: 8 34 enrollment file, I D card. Data it produces: Eligibility (enrollment span) rows: member, group, plan, start and end dates.

lines.raw: Check-in. Created by: Clinic ↔ insurer. Transaction / document: **270** inquiry / **271** response. Data it produces: Eligibility check log: was the member active, copay, deductible left.
lines.say: Check-in. Created by: Clinic ↔ insurer. Transaction or document: 2 70 inquiry or 2 71 response. Data it produces: Eligibility check log: was the member active, copay, deductible left.

lines.raw: Consultation. Created by: Doctor. Transaction / document: Clinical note in the **EHR**. Data it produces: Medical record (stays with the provider; not sent as a bill).
lines.say: Consultation. Created by: Doctor. Transaction or document: Clinical note in the E H R. Data it produces: Medical record (stays with the provider; not sent as a bill).

lines.raw: Coding & claim. Created by: Clinic / coder. Transaction / document: **CMS-1500** (doctors) or **UB-04** (hospitals). Data it produces: Diagnosis and procedure codes, charges, NPIs.
lines.say: Coding and claim. Created by: Clinic or coder. Transaction or document: C M S 1500 (doctors) or U B 04 (hospitals). Data it produces: Diagnosis and procedure codes, charges, N P I's.

lines.raw: EDI conversion. Created by: Clinic software. Transaction / document: **837P** or **837I**. Data it produces: The electronic claim the insurer loads.
lines.say: E D I conversion. Created by: Clinic software. Transaction or document: 8 3 7 P or 8 3 7 I. Data it produces: The electronic claim the insurer loads.

lines.raw: Clearinghouse. Created by: Clearinghouse. Transaction / document: **999** / **277CA** acknowledgements. Data it produces: Accepted or rejected status, with error codes.
lines.say: Clearinghouse. Created by: Clearinghouse. Transaction or document: 999 or 2 7 7 C A acknowledgements. Data it produces: Accepted or rejected status, with error codes.

lines.raw: Payer validation & adjudication. Created by: Insurer. Transaction / document: Internal claim system. Data it produces: Medical claim lines: billed, allowed, paid, patient share, CARC codes, status.
lines.say: Payer validation and adjudication. Created by: Insurer. Transaction or document: Internal claim system. Data it produces: Medical claim lines: billed, allowed, paid, patient share, C A R C codes, status.

lines.raw: Provider payment. Created by: Insurer → clinic. Transaction / document: **EFT** + **835** remittance. Data it produces: Payment and remittance rows: paid date, trace number, adjustments.
lines.say: Provider payment. Created by: Insurer to clinic. Transaction or document: E F T and 8 35 remittance. Data it produces: Payment and remittance rows: paid date, trace number, adjustments.

lines.raw: EOB. Created by: Insurer → patient. Transaction / document: Explanation of Benefits. Data it produces: A letter, built from the claim data.
lines.say: E O B. Created by: Insurer to patient. Transaction or document: Explanation of Benefits. Data it produces: A letter, built from the claim data.

lines.raw: Patient bill. Created by: Provider → patient. Transaction / document: Statement. Data it produces: Provider's accounts receivable (not in insurer data).
lines.say: Patient bill. Created by: Provider to patient. Transaction or document: Statement. Data it produces: Provider's accounts receivable (not in insurer data).

lines.raw: Pharmacy (outside the simulator). Created by: Pharmacy ↔ PBM. Transaction / document: **NCPDP** pharmacy claim. Data it produces: Pharmacy claim rows: NDC, quantity, days supply, copay, plan paid.
lines.say: Pharmacy (outside the simulator). Created by: Pharmacy ↔ P B M. Transaction or document: N C P D P pharmacy claim. Data it produces: Pharmacy claim rows: N D C, quantity, days supply, copay, plan paid.

lines.raw: Running totals. Created by: Insurer. Transaction / document: Accumulators. Data it produces: Deductible and out-of-pocket used so far this year.
lines.say: Running totals. Created by: Insurer. Transaction or document: Accumulators. Data it produces: Deductible and out-of-pocket used so far this year.

lines.raw: Getting cover. Ram (private insurance): Startup buys a group policy. Sita (SSF): Enrolled through employer contributions. Emily (US PPO): Chooses a plan at open enrollment; 834 file.
lines.say: Getting cover. Ram (private insurance): Startup buys a group policy. Sita (S S F): Enrolled through employer contributions. Emily (U S P P O): Chooses a plan at open enrollment; 8 34 file.

lines.raw: Going for care. Ram (private insurance): Any hospital or clinic. Sita (SSF): SSF-listed hospital. Emily (US PPO): In-network provider.
lines.say: Going for care. Ram (private insurance): Any hospital or clinic. Sita (S S F): S S F listed hospital. Emily (U S P P O): In-network provider.

lines.raw: Checking cover. Ram (private insurance): Not at the hospital. Sita (SSF): Hospital checks SSF membership. Emily (US PPO): 270/271 in seconds.
lines.say: Checking cover. Ram (private insurance): Not at the hospital. Sita (S S F): Hospital checks S S F membership. Emily (U S P P O): 2 70/2 71 in seconds.

lines.raw: Coding. Ram (private insurance): Usually none. Sita (SSF): Diagnosis and services recorded. Emily (US PPO): ICD-10, CPT, modifiers.
lines.say: Coding. Ram (private insurance): Usually none. Sita (S S F): Diagnosis and services recorded. Emily (U S P P O): I C D 10, C P T, modifiers.

lines.raw: Sending the claim. Ram (private insurance): Ram submits receipts himself. Sita (SSF): Hospital claims from SSF. Emily (US PPO): 837P through a clearinghouse.
lines.say: Sending the claim. Ram (private insurance): Ram submits receipts himself. Sita (S S F): Hospital claims from S S F. Emily (U S P P O): 8 3 7 P through a clearinghouse.

lines.raw: Deciding the claim. Ram (private insurance): Insurer checks the policy. Sita (SSF): SSF checks approved rates and limits. Emily (US PPO): Ten checks plus fee schedule adjudication.
lines.say: Deciding the claim. Ram (private insurance): Insurer checks the policy. Sita (S S F): S S F checks approved rates and limits. Emily (U S P P O): Ten checks plus fee schedule adjudication.

lines.raw: Who gets the money. Ram (private insurance): Ram (reimbursement). Sita (SSF): The hospital (80%). Emily (US PPO): The clinic, by EFT with an 835.
lines.say: Who gets the money. Ram (private insurance): Ram (reimbursement). Sita (S S F): The hospital (80 percent). Emily (U S P P O): The clinic, by E F T with an 8 35.

lines.raw: Patient's paper. Ram (private insurance): Settlement message. Sita (SSF): Hospital receipt for 20%. Emily (US PPO): EOB, and a bill only if money is owed.
lines.say: Patient's paper. Ram (private insurance): Settlement message. Sita (S S F): Hospital receipt for 20 percent. Emily (U S P P O): E O B, and a bill only if money is owed.
